correctness.rationale: Dihedral averaging is valid for the concave unnormalized Laplacian gap and preserves total price. Fourier nontrivial block f(x+c_m y,z) and constant-sector quadratic u(x,z) give exact lambda2=min(f,u). Unit-gap constraints are z>1,x+c_m y>=g(z)=2+1/(z-1), x>=h_m(z)=(2z-1)/((2m+1)z-(m+1)); both are necessary and sufficient after checking larger roots. For fixed z linear expenditure chooses x=g or h according to sign of P-Q/c_m. Scalar convexity gives unique z root in mixed regime; at equality x continuum. Averaging preserves orbit totals and nonnegativity, hence the claims about every asymmetric optimum. Independently diagonalized 60 full helm matrices across regimes. Finite tests corroborate universal proof.
